hook: In October 2026, 453 product recalls were recorded across federal agencies.

sections.voiceover: In October 2026, 453 product recalls were recorded across federal agencies.
The CPSC, FDA, NHTSA, and USDA-FSIS tracked these safety events throughout October 2026 for consumers. Which agency issued the most of the 138 recalls posted by October 29, 2026?
The NHTSA alone posted 73 of these dangerous product recall events.
Review data shows 153 of these incidents were classified as severe threats. Moderate incidents reached 181 total events.
October 2026 ended with 453 total safety product recalls recorded.
